page.overview:
What is Moon?

The Moon is a non-canon plane subtype featured in Doctor Who on the card The Moonbase.

The Moon, also known as Luna, is Earth's largest and only natural satellite. Humans used it as a base from which to thwart multiple alien invasions including those by the Cyberman, [https://tardis.fandom.com/wiki/Ice_Warrior Ice Warriors] (Iraxxa, Empress of Mars), and the [https://tardis.fandom.com/wiki/Silent Silents] (Renegade Silent). Unbeknownst to most humans who lived on Earth was that the Moon itself was an alien species — the embryonic form of a gigantic, draconian creature. Its hatching caused one of the worst natural disasters in Earth's history with tides swelling and consuming whole cites. However, after the creature hatched, it laid a new egg — a "new moon" — which seemed very like the one that it had replaced.
